did.description: DID of the account that caused the notification.

avatar.description: Avatar image. May be a path relative to the mochott origin (/api/image/{did}/{cid}) or an absolute URL.

handle.description: Handle, or "unknown" when the profile could not be resolved.

url.description: Absolute URL of the mochott page the notification opens: the article, the comic chapter, strip or series, or the subscriber's profile. Absent for imports and for works no longer indexed.

commentUri.description: For comment, reply, comic_comment and comic_reply: the comment that caused the notification (the reply itself for replies). Absent for notifications created before it was recorded.

commentText.description: The content of commentUri. Absent when the comment has been deleted.

documentUri.description: The article, comic chapter or strip, or comic series the notification is about. Null for subscriptions and imports.

documentTitle.description: Title of the subject. For import_completed and import_failed it is "<processed>|<failed>".

notificationView.description: A notification for the requesting account. url, commentUri and commentText are only returned when the request names types or continues a keyset cursor.
